rationale: The bug is on line 14-15: the try-except block catches TypeError and AttributeError (which occur when stored_token or expiry are None, or token is not a string), but silently swallows these exceptions with 'pass'. This means invalid token data (missing token/expiry fields) fails validation silently instead of surfacing an error. This is significant because it masks data corruption in the token_store - other code populating the store may be failing to set required fields, and this function hides that failure mode entirely, allowing broken state to persist undetected.
